summary: Auto-stereoscopic displays that use a lenticular lens or barrier layer to separate left/right eye views without glasses. All consume SR Weave format delivered via DisplayPort 1.4. Require display vendor SDK software to activate 3D mode.

sr_weave.notes: SR Weave native output with 3DGameBridge ReShade addon. Headtracking enabled for Leia Track support.

sbs.notes: Side-by-side output. 3DGameBridge converts to SR Weave.

anaglyph.notes: Anaglyph output. Converted via ReShade 3DToElse shader; no head tracking in ColoredGlass mode.

sr_weave.notes: Fix outputs SR Weave natively — no conversion needed.

constraints.notes: 3DGameBridge does not support Vulkan. Use sbs_vulkan path instead.
ShaderGlass captures Vulkan output and re-presents as DX11 for 3DGameBridge.

vrto3d.notes: VRto3D outputs SBS which 3DGameBridge ReShade addon (running on vrserver.exe) converts to SR Weave.

xrgamebridge.notes: Preferred over VRto3D on SR displays — OpenXR native, lower latency. UEVR must be set to OpenXR mode.

headtracking.notes: Leia Track provides head-position data via OpenTrack UDP. Set OpenTrack output to 'freetrack 2.0 enhanced'.

family_software.name: 3DGameBridge
family_software.notes: ReShade addon that routes SBS/TAB output through the Leia SR SDK to produce SR Weave. Works on all SR displays.

family_software.name: NewAxis
family_software.notes: Cross-SR-display launcher. Runs most TrueGame-compatible content on any SR display, not just Acer. Does not cover TrueGame-exclusive titles. Primary way to play TrueGame content on Samsung Odyssey 3D or Asus Spatial Vision.

family_software.name: LeiaSR Platform
family_software.notes: Underlying SDK that 3DGameBridge and XRGameBridge depend on. If 3DGameBridge shows 'Unable to load all SR DLLs', add LeiaSR Platform bin to PATH and reboot.

devices.name: Acer SpatialLabs View / SpatialLabs View Pro

device_software.name: Acer TrueGame
device_software.cross_device_notes: Most TrueGame content can be played on other SR displays via NewAxis. Some titles are TrueGame-exclusive and cannot currently be played on other hardware.

device_software.name: SpatialLabs Experience Center
device_software.notes: Acer's display management and activation software. Required to enable 3D mode.

setup_notes: Install SpatialLabs Experience Center from Acer to enable 3D mode.
Install LeiaSR Platform — required for 3DGameBridge and XRGameBridge.
If 3DGameBridge shows 'Status: Inactive — Unable to load SR DLLs': run cmd /k setx PATH "C:\Program Files\LeiaSR\Platform\bin;%PATH%" then reboot.
TrueGame content: use Acer TrueGame directly, or NewAxis for cross-device access.

devices.name: Samsung Odyssey 3D

device_software.name: Samsung Odyssey 3D Hub
device_software.notes: Samsung's own 3D game launcher. Exclusive to Odyssey 3D — its game library cannot be accessed on other SR displays. No cross-device equivalent currently exists for Odyssey Hub exclusive titles.

quirks: High refresh rate (165Hz) — set display_frequency: 165 in VRto3D default_config.json for smoothest output.
TrueGame content: use NewAxis — Odyssey Hub is exclusive and not a substitute.
Samsung Gaming Hub is separate from Odyssey 3D Hub — ensure correct software is installed.
setup_notes: Install LeiaSR Platform for 3DGameBridge / XRGameBridge support.
Set display_frequency to 165 (or your preferred rate) in VRto3D config.
To play Acer TrueGame content: install NewAxis — it bridges most TrueGame titles to the Odyssey 3D.
Samsung Odyssey 3D Hub is for Samsung's own curated 3D titles only.

devices.name: Asus ProArt Spatial Vision / Asus ROG Spatial Vision

device_software.name: Asus Spatial Vision Hub
device_software.notes: Required for 3D mode activation on Asus Spatial Vision displays.

quirks: No exclusive game launcher — uses NewAxis for TrueGame content and standard 3DGameBridge pipeline otherwise.
setup_notes: Install Asus Spatial Vision Hub to enable 3D mode.
Install LeiaSR Platform for 3DGameBridge / XRGameBridge support.

devices.name: Dimenco SR Display
quirks: Original Dimenco display — predecessor to SpatialLabs line. Uses same LeiaSR / 3DGameBridge pipeline.
